name: Ночной ритуал — объёмная изометрия
request: Взять вариант 02 за основу и сделать объёмную изометрию.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, reference-guided camera and rendering transformation.
The reference is the approved color and art direction for an original browser action RPG: a bald martial-arts monk fighting in a ruined temple at night, bright magenta ritual light on one side, cyan light on the other, pale tiled combat floor, charcoal shadows, crisp pixel-art texture.
Create the NEXT version of THIS SAME DESIGN with a radically different camera and genuinely three-dimensional form. Rebuild the reference as a VOLUMETRIC ISOMETRIC GAME SCENE. This is not a flat image rotation. Orthographic three-quarter camera, azimuth 45 degrees and elevation about 35 degrees. The courtyard floor must recede diagonally in TWO axes forming a diamond with one corner toward the viewer. Show large obvious front and side faces of stone blocks, tall solid round columns with faceted curved sides, stepped stairs with risers, substantial carved rear walls and a temple arch. Visible contact shadows, occlusion, bevel highlights, floor relief and cast shadows make all architecture solid. Lower or cut away the front wall for clear gameplay visibility.
Retain the reference's exact emotional color relationship: saturated hot raspberry-magenta light from ritual braziers on the left, electric turquoise-cyan light from ritual braziers on the right, cool ivory readable floor in the center, dark plum-black surrounding stone. Keep yellow only as a tiny accent. It is night. No daylight, sunset, warm sandstone or dominant amber lighting.
At center a small full-body adult bald monk, white sleeveless martial-arts tunic, black loose trousers, wine-red trailing waist sash, bronze fist wraps. Give him a visibly sculptural solid full-body 3D cel-shaded form and low powerful palm-strike pose; see chest, face, arms and legs at the oblique camera angle. Three short sharp cyan silhouettes trail behind his diagonal dash, one brief coral impact arc in front. Six dark hooded spear-and-shield temple guardians spaced around him with coherent same camera and solid dimensional silhouettes. Character height around 13 percent of the frame height: a usable room-scale action view, not a character portrait. Full fighters remain readable without front columns covering them. The circular mandala from the reference becomes an oblique ellipse on the floor.
Style: high-quality stylized 2.5D / low-poly 3D game art with hand-crafted pixelated texture detailing, crisp stepped contour accents and restrained pixel dithering in shadows, but genuinely solid sculptural architecture and bodies. Deliberate shapes, graphic cel shading, no plastic gloss. Blend Hades-like dimensional readable staging with the reference's Hotline Miami color punch. Preserve the ancient temple setting, bell, ritual braziers and monk identity. Environment fills a widescreen 16:9 composition, game-camera view. No floating toy diorama, no top-down camera, no flat floor plan, no realistic photography, no generic cinematic blur, no pixel voxel cubes, no guns or sci-fi machinery, no UI, captions, logos, labels, borders or watermark.
